meta.label: not pre-registered
meta.note: The held-out splits as recorded once, each with the code and prompts of its day, pooled and re-analysed with the final run's statistics after their results were known.

methods.published_ci: the scorer's interval as docs/evals.md publishes it: a percentile bootstrap over letters, a Wilson interval over letters at a rate of 0 or 1
methods.paired_one_read: exact McNemar (two-sided) on the discordant pairs, mid-p beside it; Bonett-Price interval
methods.paired_clustered: sign-flip test over letter clusters (exact up to 20 non-zero clusters, else 100000 seeded draws); paired cluster bootstrap, 10000 resamples, percentile interval
methods.verdict: clear: the Holm-adjusted exact p and the Holm-adjusted cluster sign-flip p both below 0.05, and the Bonett-Price interval excludes 0; suggestive: the unadjusted mid-p below 0.05; else no clear difference
methods.tiers: please_check: low confidence, Please check, or found without a date; second_look: medium confidence; none: no flag, or missed (a missed deadline shows nothing, so it counts among the deadlines without a flag)
methods.selective_reads: one read: every item once; over repeated reads, read 1's items, and each wrong date counted once (caught: flagged Please check in every read in which it was wrong)
methods.mean_over_reads: cluster bootstrap, percentile interval; Clopper-Pearson over the clusters when every resample is equal
methods.aurc: risk-coverage from the most confident tier down, errors spread evenly within a tier
methods.loss: per 100 scored items: early + r * harmful
methods.crossover: r at which the losses are equal, when they cross; letter-cluster bootstrap, 2000 resamples: the share of each outcome (a lower then b, b lower then a, a lower at every r, b lower at every r, identical), and the percentile interval of r over the resamples that cross the same way as the point estimate

rules_text_claim.text: 14 vs 5 discordant, exact p 0.064, Holm-adjusted 0.127 (mid-p 0.041, Holm-adjusted 0.083): suggestive, not settled

rules_text_crossover.text: Ordnung's harm-weighted loss is the lower one until a late or missed date costs 5.5 early ones; in 76 % of 2,000 resamples of the letters the losses cross the same way (95 % of those crossings between 1.2 and 16.0), and in 24 % Ordnung's loss is the lower one whatever a harmful date costs
